messages:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — the prefetch-dither change landed to canary ~45m ago and we're seeing p95 decode spikes on shortseq workloads :eyes:
Priya Nair: noticed that too. KV hit-rate drops and batch-size oscillation correlate with the spikes. attaching quick profiler snippet below.
Priya Nair: ```
profile: shortseq-run-2026-03-18
- total tokens: 1.2M
- p50 decode: 12ms
- p95 decode: 58ms (was ~22ms before merge)
- kv_cache_miss_rate: 14% (baseline 1.2%)
- AttnKernelChooser.choose: generic_attn selected 92% for seq<64
```
Jorge Martinez: ran a git-bisect across the last 20 merges. bisect points to commit 7c9b2f3 (prefetch-dither + kernel-chooser refactor). the chooser change subtly prefers the generic path on jittered prefetch timing.
Linh Vo: graph from canary shows batcher shrinking mean batch size from 14 -> 3 during the oscillation windows, which amplifies per-request overhead. looks like prefetch jitter causes early-dequeue in the adaptive batcher.
Alex Chen: repro steps I used:
```
# synthetic repro that replicates the p95 spike
python perf_runner.py --model redwood/opt-6.7b --seq-length 32 --qps 180 --prefix-cache=on --burst=short
# observed: AttnKernelChooser.choose -> generic_attn chosen 98% (avg +1.2ms/token => + ~36ms seq32)
```
Priya Nair: deploy-bot just paused the canary: "deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by perf-guard (p95 > 2x)"
deploy-bot: :info: Canary paused at 7c9b2f3 after automated perf check failed.
Jorge Martinez: quick diff of the chooser: 7c9b2f3 changed the warmup gating to sample prefetch latency and if jitter>0.4ms prefer generic kernel. seems reasonable but the prefetch path now reports noisy latencies while warm-up is ongoing.
Linh Vo: hypothesis: prefetch dither added micro-delays; combined with KV cache warm-up the latency tail flips kernel choice incorrectly for the majority of shortseq requests. that yields both extra op cost and smaller batches.
Alex Chen: options: 1) revert commit 7c9b2f3 (fast but crude) 2) hotfix chooser to ignore prefetch-sample for first N warmup batches 3) tweak batcher to be less sensitive to single-request latency jitter.
Priya Nair: opened PR #4322 (revert 7c9b2f3) as a stopgap. also have PR #4323 that adds a 50ms stabilization window to the chooser heuristic.
Jorge Martinez: ran bisect + microbench: applying the stabilization patch to canary restores p95 to ~24ms in my local microbench.
Alex Chen: SRE, can you confirm rollback and monitor?
sre-bot: :warning: Revert PR #4322 merged to canary; rollback initiated. Monitoring p50/p95 for the next 15m.
sre-bot: current canary metrics snapshot: p95 decode back to 23ms, kv_miss_rate dropping toward baseline.
Priya Nair: I'll prepare a follow-up that keeps the prefetch dither but uses a smoother estimator (EWMA) for the chooser sampling. avoids the abrupt flip.
Linh Vo: also adding a canary test that exercises shortseq+cold-prefetch pattern to CI to catch this next time.
Alex Chen: thanks team. next actions: (1) monitor canary for 1h, (2) ship stabilization patch (#4323) behind a feature-flag, (3) add CI perf test for shortseq prefetch scenario. I'll post status in ~30m. :thumbsup:
